set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 /* * The XML returned from the BillingService is not well formed (multiple tags at the same level, etc). * * This setVariable converts the xml to json and transforms the duplicate tags into an array. * * reference: https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=001116941&type=1 */ output application/json duplicateKeyAsArray=true --- payload.Envelope.Body.PrimaryAccountResponse]

json-logger:logger.doc:name: Before billing call
json-logger:logger.message: #["SB-PA-A: Before billing call for billingAccountNumber: "++ vars.billingAccountNumber default "EMPTY"]

json-logger:logger.doc:name: After billing call
json-logger:logger.json-logger:content:
#[import modules::JSONLoggerModule import * from dw::util::Timer output application/json
var currentTimeMillis = currentMilliseconds() --- { identifier:"BSC-01", isDuckcreek: (vars.billingAccountNumber startsWith "6000"), billingAccountNumber: vars.billingAccountNumber, elapsed: (currentTimeMillis - (vars.requestResponseLog.entryTimeMillis default 0)) }]

json-logger:logger.doc:name: log fault
json-logger:logger.message: SB-PA-C: Error Detected: Account not found
